subject: Turning drawings into manufactured components
hook: What do you need from me before you can start cutting?
fb:
The question we get most from new trade customers: what do you actually need from me before you can start?

Here is the short version. Finished sizes and quantities for every part. The board decor and thickness. Grain direction where it matters. Which edges get ABS edging and at what thickness. Any drilling, like hinge cups or shelf-pin rows. And whether you are collecting from our Hanley workshop, want it delivered, or would like us to assemble it.

If you only have a drawing, send that and we will talk it through with you.

Ask us a trade production question here:
https://superiofurniture.com/trade-services/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=entertaining-spaces-and-pre-christmas-planning&utm_content=day-105
gbp:
What information do you need before cutting trade components?

To price and produce your components accurately, we need:

- Finished sizes and quantities for every part
- Board decor, finish and thickness
- Grain direction on woodgrain boards
- Which edges need ABS edging, and whether 0.4, 1 or 2 mm
- Any drilling: hinge cups, shelf-pin rows, dowels
- Collection, delivery or assembly

If you only have drawings, send them and we will work through the cutting list with you before anything is cut. Every part is labelled to match your list, so sorting on site is simple.

Our workshop is in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent, and handles panel cutting, edge banding, drilling and cabinet assembly. Trade and domestic orders welcome.
